assessments.name: Q+A following presentation
assessments.description: Question and answer session following the group presentations in weeks 2, 3 and 4.  Questions will be asked to all group members.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Small MCQ tests
assessments.description: 3x MCQ tests worth 10% each (30% total) on Friday of Weeks 2, 3 and 4. These MCQ tests will be pen-and-paper, in-person during class time.

assessments.name: Self-reflection activities
assessments.description: MCQ and SA questions to help self-evaluate current and gained knowledge. Assessment is pen-and-paper, in-person during class time.

assessments.name: Group presentations
assessments.description: 3x in-person group presentations (10% each) on Friday of Weeks 2, 3 and 4, where Socrative discussion about a prescribed journal article is led by the examiner to assess students ability to present and critically appraise the selected literature.

assessments.name: Q+A following final presentation
assessments.description: Question and answer session following the final group presentation. Questions will be asked to all group members.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Final group presentation
assessments.description: Group presentation of a journal article, where Socrative discussion about the article is led by the examiner to asses students ability to present and critically appraise the select literature.
